---
title: "Stitched vs ED Overlay (Last 3 Seasons)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

start_date <- mdy('07/01/2022')
end_date   <- start_date + years(3) - days(1)

# Load latest stitched hospitalizations (final stitched time series)
stitched_dir <- '../data/imputed_sets'
stitched_files <- list.files(stitched_dir, pattern = '^imputed_and_stitched_hosp_\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\\.csv$', full.names = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(stitched_files) > 0)

get_date <- function(x, prefix) as.Date(sub(paste0('^', prefix, '_(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2})\\.csv$'), '\\1', basename(x)))
stitched_dates <- get_date(stitched_files, 'imputed_and_stitched_hosp')
imputed_file <- stitched_files[which.max(stitched_dates)]

df_hosp <- readr::read_csv(imputed_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  select(date, location_name, total_hosp)

# Redownload ED data (percent of ED visits for influenza)
base_url <- 'https://data.cdc.gov/resource/rdmq-nq56.json'

fetch_ed <- function(start_dt, limit = 50000) {
  offset <- 0L
  out <- list()
  # Restrict to last three seasons and county=='All' to reduce volume
  where <- paste0("county='All' AND week_end >= '", format(start_dt, '%Y-%m-%d'), "T00:00:00.000'")
  repeat {
    resp <- GET(base_url, query = list(
      "$select" = "week_end,geography,county,percent_visits_influenza",
      "$where"  = where,
      "$limit"  = limit,
      "$offset" = offset
    ))
    stopifnot(status_code(resp) == 200)
    dat <- fromJSON(content(resp, 'text', encoding = 'UTF-8'), flatten = TRUE)
    if (length(dat) == 0) break
    out[[length(out) + 1L]] <- dat
    if (nrow(dat) < limit) break
    offset <- offset + limit
  }
  if (length(out) == 0) return(tibble())
  bind_rows(out)
}

raw_ed <- fetch_ed(start_date)

df_ed <- raw_ed %>%
  transmute(
    date = as.Date(week_end),
    location_name = ifelse(geography == 'United States', 'US', geography),
    ed_pct_influenza = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(percent_visits_influenza))
  )

# Prepare merged frame for plotting within the desired window
df <- df_hosp %>%
  left_join(df_ed, by = c('date', 'location_name')) %>%
  filter(date >= start_date, date <= end_date)

safe_rescale <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(rng[1]) || !is.finite(rng[2]) || rng[1] == rng[2]) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  (x - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
}

plot_df <- df %>%
  group_by(location_name) %>%
  mutate(hosp_scaled = safe_rescale(total_hosp),
         ed_scaled   = safe_rescale(ed_pct_influenza)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(date, location_name, `Hospitalizations` = hosp_scaled, `ED%` = ed_scaled) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Hospitalizations`, `ED%`), names_to = 'series', values_to = 'value') %>%
  filter(!is.na(value))
```

```{r fig.align='center', fig.width=12, fig.height=22}
ggplot(plot_df, aes(date, value, color = series)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`Hospitalizations` = 'black', `ED%` = '#D62728'), name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~location_name, ncol = 5) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
```
